fills.quote: Increases ship health by +25% [partly covered by webcam] and ranged armor by +1.
fills.note: The webcam partly covers '+25%'; zoomed in it reads 25% (same at 23:40, s_01420). The narrator says '50%'. Also +1 ranged armor.
fills.tieReason: In s_01418 (and the same tooltip in s_01420) the webcam covers only the bottom half of the digits. A pixel map of the top half shows a clearly flat-topped '5'. The first digit has a rounded top whose stroke stays on the right and then slants down-left at mid-height. It has no middle bar, so it is a 2, not a 3. The full line reads 'Increases ship health by +25% and ranged armor by +1.' This matches the fully legible tooltip in uNw-K34ZDPs s_01548, the Chinese tooltip in BV1dSny6uE4j_p1 ('25%') and the jeando datamined text.

fills.name: Folkekirken
fills.quote: 'Folkekirken completed'; population 128/220 (was 124/200 at 24:34 before the cathedral)
fills.note: No Folkekirken tooltip in this batch. Max population went 200 to 220 with Kongens Dør (+10, per its tooltip) and Folkekirken, so Folkekirken is taken as +10 maximum population.
fills.tieReason: The toast does not print a number, but the HUD population counter shows the effect directly. Across s_01474 to s_01540 the max population goes 124/200, then 128/210 at 22:59 (Age IV/cathedral), then 128/220 at 23:07, the exact frame where the 'Folkekirken completed' toast first appears. It stays at 220 afterwards. So Folkekirken adds +10 maximum population, which matches the tooltip text from another video and the datamined text ('Increases population and maximum population by +10').
